turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Rajesh from your bank's KYC compliance department.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your KYC has expired and your account will be suspended permanently if not updated today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For security verification, I need you to read out the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not share this OTP with anyone else. This is a confidential bank process.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't provide the OTP within 15 minutes, your account will be frozen and you'll lose access to your funds.
